taxonomy.detection_mechanism: Deterministic Regional Bounds Envelope (8 Indian Climate Zones)
taxonomy.scientific_basis: IMD Pune historical extremes and thermodynamic limits (WMO-No. 8).
taxonomy.technician_action: Inspect transducer integrity, wiring short-circuits, and ADC voltage reference.

taxonomy.detection_mechanism: Consecutive Variance & Frozen Digit Detector (>= 5 consecutive identical readings)
taxonomy.scientific_basis: Natural diurnal atmospheric variation precludes constant temperature/humidity readings over multi-hour intervals.
taxonomy.technician_action: Check transducer communication bus, logger analog input channel, and data logger firmware freeze.

taxonomy.detection_mechanism: Causal CUSUM & Monotonic Linear Drift State Machine (cumulative drift > 2.5 sigma)
taxonomy.scientific_basis: Aging sensor elements (e.g. platinum RTD resistance shift or capacitive polymer degradation) cause slow monotonic bias.
taxonomy.technician_action: Perform field calibration comparison using travelling standard (e.g. Vaisala PTB330 barometer or certified reference thermometer).

taxonomy.detection_mechanism: Concentric KD-Tree Buddy Check (tolerance: 2.0°C; anomaly flag: >= 4.0°C delta)
taxonomy.scientific_basis: Homogeneous microclimates within 20 km under identical synoptic conditions cannot sustain large thermal gradients without topographical cause.
taxonomy.technician_action: Inspect solar radiation shield cleanliness, aspiration fan functionality, and local heat source obstructions.

taxonomy.detection_mechanism: Elevation Lapse-Rate Adjusted Buddy Check (tolerance: 3.5°C with -6.5°C/km ELR)
taxonomy.scientific_basis: Mesoscale terrain-adjusted consensus accounts for elevation differences via environmental lapse rate.
taxonomy.technician_action: Verify station elevation metadata in master catalog; inspect sensor calibration offset.

taxonomy.detection_mechanism: Altimeter-Reduced Hydrostatic Peer Consensus (residual > 4.5 sigma, > 12 hPa)
taxonomy.scientific_basis: Atmospheric pressure is regionally coherent; hydrostatic reduction to MSLP enables strict buddy checking across large distances.
taxonomy.technician_action: Check barometer port vent tube for water accumulation, insect blockage, or pressure transducer offset.

taxonomy.detection_mechanism: Spatial Consensus & Saturation Envelope Check (residual > 4.8 sigma, > 25% RH difference)
taxonomy.scientific_basis: Capacitive hygrometers frequently fail by saturating at 100% or reading near 0% due to polymer contamination.
taxonomy.technician_action: Inspect capacitive humidity sensor filter cap for dust/chemical contamination; replace sensor element if contaminated.

taxonomy.detection_mechanism: Temporal Step-Rate & Reconstruction Error (isolated single-sample deviation returning to baseline)
taxonomy.scientific_basis: Electrical EMI spikes, lightning induction, or telemetry bit-flips cause transient non-physical spikes.
taxonomy.technician_action: Inspect electrical grounding, cable shielding, and surge protection modules.

taxonomy.detection_mechanism: Synoptic Front Coherence Discriminator (>= 50% neighbor stations shift with >= 3.0°C step drop)
taxonomy.scientific_basis: Thunderstorm gust fronts, squalls, or cold fronts cause rapid multi-station temperature drops that naive QC misclassifies as sensor faults.
taxonomy.technician_action: Zero maintenance required. Suppress sensor fault alerts and log as genuine atmospheric event.
